environment.camera_profile_change_note: The capture-time and current files differ only in comments describing legacy lane annotations; the locked intrinsics, camera identities and camera poses are unchanged and are independently hashed below.
environment.capture_overlay_rule: The capture-only models may add semantic-label sensors, but their RGB camera definitions must remain byte-identical to the locked source models.

detector.rule: Raw RGB and semantic support are captured first; every downstream detector pass uses exactly this frozen checkpoint unless a dated lock amendment is made before any final fitting.

sampling.opportunity_definition: one scheduled camera in one static position-heading-repetition batch
sampling.repetition_interpretation: There is one frame per declared heading; repeated evidence at a position is supplied by four declared headings, not pseudo-replication of an identical frame.

rules: All headings, repetitions and cameras for one position remain in exactly one role.
D_mu fits the shared correction; D_R fits R0/R1/R2 only from frozen out-of-sample corrected residuals; D_dev selects frozen hyperparameters; final_audit fits or selects nothing.
Final-audit image content may be accessed only for integrity checks until detector, gate, correction, covariance and planning-information choices are frozen.

weighting.reporting_rule: Aggregate within position first, then summarize positions with equal weight; camera-specific summaries use equal position weight within camera.
weighting.spatial_support_rule: Repeated headings or frames at one position count as one spatial support location.

opportunity_accounting.planning_target: inverse(R_run) for an admitted opportunity, otherwise the zero 2x2 information matrix

capture_implementation.pose_validity: oriented 0.80 x 0.55 m footprint plus 0.05 m clearance at every sampled heading

prohibitions: Do not tune or select using final_audit.
Do not drop detector misses or deterministic gate refusals from opportunity denominators.
Do not split frames from one physical position across roles or folds.
Do not use ground truth, semantic masks, innovations or NIS in the runtime sensor gate.
Do not fit a separate q_i(p) availability model.
Do not pool this Track-B campaign with earlier drive-based or v3/v4 development evidence.
